Where the Icon comes from: <icon set> [name in that set] [properties]

The icon set is any name you use for a source, such as google, fontAwesome, lucide or custom. It becomes a Sources filter in the preview page.

The name is what the icon is called in that set, and is searchable. A google entry that has one also links to the icon on Google Fonts.

Each property becomes a Variants filter. These three are given a title:
  - fill: the filled variant
  - w100 to w700: the stroke weight
  - s20, s24, s40, s48: the optical size
